objective: Reconcile raw Zenodo g/r photometry row counts and SNR candidate membership against all 781,602 Table2 objects, with explicit Table4 crosswalk and 55 complete-metadata controls.
previous_knowledge_consumed: Table4 crosswalk contains 730,184 unique Table2 Seq IDs; candidate set contains 741,786; candidate-only residuals are 11,602; published-only IDs are zero.
The four positive fields gmag, rmag, Per-g and Per-r select all 730,184 Table4 IDs inside the reconstructed candidate set, with zero Table4 omissions.
Across all 781,602 parent objects, 730,239 pass the four-field predicate; the additional 55 are the fixed four_field_only controls and are not in the reconstructed candidate set.

A pinned raw-archive audit of the 55 controls is PARTIAL: only one has g-band rows, 51 have r-band rows, and no control has both bands represented. Raw row counts match Table2 Ng for one object and Nr for 51 objects.
The 55-control report explicitly warns that row-count mismatches must be resolved before interpreting the apparent SNR failure.
The Zenodo raw fields are documented as SourceID, RAdeg, DEdeg, MJD, mag, e_mag and flag; g_flag/r_flag have not been proven equivalent to DR2 catflags.

change.proposed: Run a single-pass, checksummed scan of all 781,602 Table2 SourceIDs against both raw Zenodo archives. Count raw and numeric-valid rows, evaluate SNR formula and flag-policy comparators, and compare per-object counts with Table2 Ng/Nr.
change.scope: Research-only script, tests, workflow and evidence artifacts; no production selector, model, feature schema or baseline changes.
change.rationale: The 55 complete-metadata controls have missing raw rows in at least one band. A full-parent row-count reconciliation is required to distinguish SNR filtering from archive incompleteness or SourceID mapping errors.

expected_improvement: Verify all raw archive rows, member sizes, row counts, CRC and SHA-256.
Produce per-object raw/valid/SNR/flag counts for all 781,602 parent IDs.
Compare SNR candidate sets with the reconstructed 741,786 candidate IDs and the 730,184 Table4 reference.
Quantify Table2 Ng/Nr versus raw row-count differences by membership cohort.
Identify all discrepant SourceIDs for follow-up coordinate and image-quality tracing.

evidence: All 781,602 parent objects were reconciled using the pinned Table2/Table4 crosswalk.
Both archive and member SHA-256, byte count, row count and CRC checks passed.
The report and both object-level TSV outputs were uploaded and their hashes recorded.

root_causes: The 11,602 residuals pass the tested raw two-band SNR reconstruction but fail the four-field Table2 complete-case predicate.
The exact role of the four-field predicate in the publisher's method is undocumented and remains unproven.
The 55 four-field-only controls have no dual-band raw coverage in the Zenodo attachments despite positive Table2 Ng/Nr.
100 objects have one or more raw/Table2 count mismatches, including published Table4 members.
limitations: Zenodo raw attachments do not contain image-level INFOBITS.
Zenodo g_flag/r_flag are not proven equivalent to DR2 catflags.
The CDS ReadMe says the r attachment has 89,697,393 records while the checksum-pinned Zenodo r member yielded 109,971,576; this archive/documentation discrepancy must be resolved.
A row-count mismatch does not by itself prove low SNR, duplicate detections or incorrect SourceID mapping.

The Zenodo record's field description calls the epoch HJD, while the CDS ReadMe calls the corresponding data-file field MJD. The actual numeric range in the attached bytes must be measured before any phase-fold interpretation is accepted.

findings: Approximate, exact and inverse-error SNR formulas yield the same 741,786 candidate set on the pinned archives.
The tested flag<32768 and flag!=32768 policies do not change the candidate set; flag==0 removes 5,472 published members.
Four-field completeness yields an exact Table4 split inside the reconstructed SNR candidates, but 55 more parent objects also have all four fields.
The raw attachments omit one or both bands for 55 of those controls; none has both raw bands.
The full parent has 100 raw/Table2 count-mismatch objects across residual, Table4, control and other-parent cohorts.

open_blockers: Trace all 100 mismatch objects to exact raw epochs and source coordinates.
Search nearby alternate SourceIDs for objects with missing raw rows.
Inspect duplicate MJD/HJD records, coordinate scatter, flag counts and photometric errors.
Resolve the CDS ReadMe versus Zenodo r-member row-count discrepancy.
Recover image-level INFOBITS and establish the exact g_flag/r_flag mapping.
Reconstruct the Chen selector stage by stage and perform final independent membership validation.
Resolve HJD versus MJD semantics using numeric raw epochs and the exact Zenodo/ CDS file versions; rerun all phase-derived analyses if the current conversion is wrong.

knowledge_carried_forward: Do not call the 55 controls low-SNR failures while raw rows are absent.
Do not infer publisher intent from exact count matching.
Do not equate Zenodo g_flag/r_flag with catflags without proof.
Do not change production selectors, models or v0.2.0.
